Soojin —

Attached is the canary execution plan (see canary-checklist.docx). Key points:
- Canary sample: 10% traffic routed through dedicated canary pool; we will mirror 100% of requests but only send 10% live traffic to model instance group to measure behavior under real traffic.
- Observability KPIs: p95 latency, error-rate >0.5% over baseline, memory GC spikes, and kv-cache hit-rate.
- Auto-rollback: threshold-based (error-rate >0.7% OR p95 latency +200ms for 10 minutes) triggers immediate route switch to fallback model and alerts paging list.
- Rollback dry-run: propose a dry-run on 6/9 (one day prior to canary) where we simulate traffic and confirm metrics pipeline.

I'll own the dry-run and the canary execution. Sharing the checklist and a short runbook.

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Redwood Inference
